record.label: K22-residual second-star carrier
record.summary: The transport-fidelity probe proved the deployed quartic star push exact on its carried family while the K22-residual channel (computed at every reset, alpha-fitted, rest discarded) is transported at exactly zero. The rank-4 carrier with an exact-on-family push (independently audited; the first build's k31 channel was exactly doubled and was caught pre-data) measured, in a sealed 200-row pilot: host raw 9.039e-8 -> 5.826e-8, minus 35.6 percent, 200 of 200 rows, t=-59.9. The refit-J diagnostic showed the additive invariant EXACT (corrected 3.133e-8 vs 3.124e-8): the carrier removed almost purely tape-reconstructable error.
record.terminal_criterion: Sealed pilot adjudicated under its frozen licensing rules.
